_names: Terminologia Anatomica individual terms (explicitly public domain)
_geometry: Apache-2.0 segmentation for cortex / deep nuclei / ventricles; hand_authored structures placed by a clinician in atlas-author.html because no attribution-free named white-matter atlas exists
_model_values_note: Integer -> label LUT for the specific segmentation you run. Print the real values first (see build.py --help) and map only what you intend to show.

superior-frontal-gyrus.name: Superior frontal gyrus
superior-frontal-gyrus.definition: The superior frontal gyrus occupies the upper margin of the frontal lobe and is continuous over the medial surface with the medial frontal gyrus.

middle-frontal-gyrus.name: Middle frontal gyrus
middle-frontal-gyrus.definition: The middle frontal gyrus lies between the superior and inferior frontal sulci.

inferior-frontal-gyrus.name: Inferior frontal gyrus
inferior-frontal-gyrus.definition: The inferior frontal gyrus lies below the inferior frontal sulcus and is divided by the anterior ramus of the lateral fissure.

precentral-gyrus.name: Precentral gyrus
precentral-gyrus.definition: The precentral gyrus lies immediately in front of the central sulcus and contains the primary motor cortex.

postcentral-gyrus.name: Postcentral gyrus
postcentral-gyrus.definition: The postcentral gyrus lies immediately behind the central sulcus and receives the somatosensory projection.

superior-temporal-gyrus.name: Superior temporal gyrus
superior-temporal-gyrus.definition: The superior temporal gyrus forms the upper border of the temporal lobe, below the lateral fissure.

precuneus.name: Precuneus
precuneus.definition: The precuneus is the quadrilateral area on the medial surface of the parietal lobe, in front of the cuneus.

cuneus.name: Cuneus
cuneus.definition: The cuneus is the wedge-shaped area on the medial surface of the occipital lobe, between the calcarine and parieto-occipital sulci.

insula.name: Insula
insula.definition: The insula is the cortical area buried in the depth of the lateral fissure, covered by the opercula.

thalamus.name: Thalamus
thalamus.definition: The thalamus is a large ovoid mass of grey matter forming much of the lateral wall of the third ventricle.

putamen.name: Putamen
putamen.definition: The putamen is the outer and larger part of the striatum, separated from the globus pallidus by a lamina of white matter.

globus-pallidus.name: Globus pallidus
globus-pallidus.definition: The globus pallidus is the medial, paler part of the lentiform nucleus.

caudate-nucleus.name: Caudate nucleus
caudate-nucleus.definition: The caudate nucleus is an elongated arched mass of grey matter closely related to the lateral ventricle throughout its length.

hippocampus.name: Hippocampus
hippocampus.definition: The hippocampus is a curved elevation of grey matter in the floor of the temporal horn of the lateral ventricle.

amygdala.name: Amygdala
amygdala.definition: The amygdaloid body is a grey mass in the roof of the terminal part of the temporal horn.

brainstem.name: Brainstem
brainstem.definition: The brainstem comprises the midbrain, pons and medulla oblongata.

cerebellum.name: Cerebellum
cerebellum.definition: The cerebellum occupies the posterior cranial fossa below the tentorium cerebelli.

lateral-ventricle.name: Lateral ventricle
lateral-ventricle.definition: The lateral ventricles are two irregular cavities within the cerebral hemispheres, communicating with the third ventricle through the interventricular foramina.

third-ventricle.name: Third ventricle
third-ventricle.definition: The third ventricle is a narrow median cleft between the two thalami.

fourth-ventricle.name: Fourth ventricle
fourth-ventricle.definition: The fourth ventricle lies between the pons and medulla in front and the cerebellum behind.

subarachnoid-space.name: Subarachnoid space
subarachnoid-space.definition: The subarachnoid space lies between the arachnoid mater and the pia mater and contains cerebrospinal fluid.

corpus-callosum.name: Corpus callosum
corpus-callosum.definition: The corpus callosum is the great transverse commissure uniting the cerebral hemispheres.

fornix.name: Fornix
fornix.definition: The fornix is a longitudinal, arch-shaped lamella of white substance situated below the corpus callosum, consisting of two symmetrical bands, one for either hemisphere.

internal-capsule.name: Internal capsule
internal-capsule.definition: The internal capsule is a broad band of white matter lying between the caudate nucleus and thalamus medially and the lentiform nucleus laterally.

external-capsule.name: External capsule
external-capsule.definition: The external capsule is a thin lamina of white matter lying between the putamen and the claustrum.

corona-radiata.name: Corona radiata
corona-radiata.definition: The corona radiata is the fan-shaped mass of projection fibres passing between the internal capsule and the cerebral cortex.

cingulum.name: Cingulum
cingulum.definition: The cingulum is the association bundle arching within the cingulate gyrus above the corpus callosum.

optic-radiation.name: Optic radiation
optic-radiation.definition: The optic radiation carries fibres from the lateral geniculate body to the visual cortex.
